messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up — we're planning to add new audit events for KMS ops (key.create/key.rotate/key.delete), RBAC mutations (policy.create/policy.update/policy.delete), and token issuance. Need a customer-facing changelog + a validation endpoint so customers can verify events match their SIEM schemas. Any concerns?

sam: ok. can you paste example events? want to confirm field names for parsing. also point out any PII risk.

olivia: sample event (will redact sensitive fields):
```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.3",
  "event_type": "kms.key.rotate",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-19T14:22:01Z",
  "actor": "service:infra-agent",
  "org_id": "org-987",
  "resource": "projects/acme/keys/primary",
  "details": {
    "key_id": "kid-12345",
    "rotation_reason": "scheduled"
  },
  "metadata": {
    "source": "redwood-inference",
    "region": "us-west-2"
  },
  "audit_id": "a1b2c3"
}
```

maria: privacy note: do NOT include key material or full ARNs with customer PII. Suggest either hashed/truncated key_id or a redacted_fields array. Also add a top-level "sensitive_fields" array so customers can programmatically ignore them.

julian: for customer validation I propose a POST /v1/audit-events/validate that accepts an array of events and returns per-event {pass|fail} and a schema diff. It should be org-scoped and require an API token. Rate-limit to avoid accidental SIEM floods.

olivia: agreed. doc location will be /docs/audit-events/schema-1.3 and we'll add a validation guide + grok/CEF examples. customers will want sample ingests for Splunk/Elasticsearch.

security-bot: NOTE: this schema change triggers SOC2 control review and a security checklist. Create ticket SEC-2026-042 and assign privacy + eng-security.

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled: 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z UTC. Canary: 10% for first 6 hours.

sam: action items: olivia = draft changelog + sample events; julian = design validate API + sample responses; maria = privacy review & PII policy; sam = SIEM sample mappings (grok/CEF). I'll own the SIEM templates.

olivia: assigning in tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SEC-3034 (added owners). Will draft a short customer email and a changelog entry.

julian: quick question about versioning: plan to publish as schema_version: 1.3 (backwards-compatible additions). Do we auto-enable for hosted accounts or require opt-in? I lean opt-in with a migration window.

maria: privacy & compliance preference: hosted accounts can be opt-in first; default off for Dedicated/Private until we provide a migration toggle in the Console. Update SOC2 documentation accordingly.

sam: also callout: this change does NOT extend log retention or export defaults — that stays as-is. We'll document how customers can route these new events to their existing sinks.

olivia: draft customer changelog blurb (first pass):
"Starting April 1, Redwood will begin emitting additional audit events for KMS operations and RBAC policy changes. These events include schema_version 1.3 and are intended to improve visibility into key lifecycle and permission changes. No secrets or key material will be emitted. Hosted customers must opt-in via the Console; Dedicated/Private customers will receive a migration guide"

julian: add sample grok for new event names: `GROK: %{DATA:ts} %{WORD:schema_version} %{DATA:event_type}` — we'll put full examples in docs.

security-bot: Reminder: add unit + integration tests to assert redaction before emit (test-audit-scrub). Also add a checklist item: KMS key policy review + proof of non-exfiltration.

maria: KMS integration note: document key mapping and the fact we never log key material. Also include KMS key policy reference and recommended customer IAM mapping.

olivia: thanks all. I'll open PRs for docs + changelog tomorrow. If no objections by EOD Friday we'll schedule the staged rollout to staging then canary. Please add any edge cases to the ticket. :thumbsup:

sam: ack. I'll prepare Splunk/CEF payloads and attach to the ticket.

julian: will mock the validate endpoint responses and add an example client script.

maria: I'll run a quick privacy checklist and ping compliance after PR.

olivia: closing loop — next update will be the PR link and a final customer email draft.
